basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: A generalist software engineer who builds systems that help people and AI work with knowledge. I structure ambiguous, fast-moving information into durable, AI-ready systems—designing the context in which engineers, operators, and agents collaborate effectively. My background spans biology and lab science, education, finance, cryptocurrency, and AI orchestration. I study applied ontology and semantic web technologies, bringing a broad, connective perspective to the problem of turning fragmented domain expertise into something searchable, actionable, and machine-readable.
